description: Hand-labelled ground truth for the bridgecrewio/Cfngoat static CloudFormation target, analyzed OFFLINE (no server, no daemon) by analyze-cloud-iam via the CloudFormation ingestor. Each probe names a resource and is matched to an analyze-cloud-iam finding by affected_resource substring. Planted vulns are real Cfngoat resources; decoys are BALONCORE negative controls (correctly-configured resources the analyzer must NOT flag). Checkov rule IDs are recorded as stable cross-tool identifiers.

vulnerabilities.rationale: Cfngoat cfngoat.yaml AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup.WebNodeSG has SecurityGroupIngress rules opening ports 22/80/3389 to CidrIp 0.0.0.0/0 (Checkov CKV_AWS_24: SSH open to the internet). The CloudFormation ingestor marks the SG public; analyze-cloud-iam flags it.

Cfngoat AWS::IAM::Policy 'excess_policy' grants Action ec2:*/s3:*/lambda:*/cloudwatch:* on Resource '*', attached to the IAM user via Users: [!Ref User]. The ingestor links the policy to the user; the over-privileged check (wildcard actions/resource) flags it.

Cfngoat CleanupRole embeds an inline policy 'lambda-execute' granting Action logs:* on Resource '*' (wildcard action + wildcard resource). Linked to the role via the Role's Policies list; flagged over-privileged.

Cfngoat CleanupRole embeds an inline policy 's3-object-delete' granting s3:GetObject/ListBucket/DeleteObject on Resource '*' (wildcard resource — can delete any object in any bucket). Flagged over-privileged on the resource wildcard.

decoys.rationale: BALONCORE negative control: a least-privilege AWS::IAM::Policy (s3:GetObject on one specific ARN, no wildcard action, no wildcard resource) attached to a user. The over-privileged check must NOT fire — the credibility-critical cloud false positive.

BALONCORE negative control: an AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup whose only ingress is restricted to 10.0.0.0/8 (no 0.0.0.0/0). The public-exposure check must NOT fire. Mirrors the open-SG planted vuln with the misconfiguration removed.
